description: Recommend worship songs for the person's current hour from The Living Bread worship catalogue: up to 5 shelves for the part of day (morning, day, evening, night), optionally tuned to a mood and language, each with a reason and up to 6 songs (title, artist, whether it is a public-domain hymn, link to play it in the app), plus links to Worship and Worship Together. Use for "something to worship to tonight". For one hymn's words and story use hymn. It cannot see what a live Worship Together room is playing and says so in live_room. local_hour should be the person's clock hour, or the shelves will suit the wrong part of day. Not for a hymn's history or words (hymn) or Scripture to read (daily_bread). The tool returns links only; songs play in the app. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

language.description: Preferred song language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. "en", "es", "pt". Optional; omit for the default catalogue.

local_hour.description: The person's local hour, 0 to 23, which picks the part of day. Defaults to the current UTC hour.

mood.description: One word for how they are: "weary", "thankful", "grieving". Optional.

name: worship_now

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

greeting.description: A one-line greeting for this hour, in the house's words.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

live_room.description: Statement that live room activity cannot be read here.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

shelves.description: Up to 5 shelves: title, why it suits this hour, and up to 6 songs (title, artist, hymn flag, link to play it).

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Worship now
